Message:
Add VulnerableApp-dependent: cross-repo vulnerable shared library and microservice

Multi-module Gradle project containing:
- vulnerable-shared-lib: Broken sanitizers, vulnerable models, hardcoded configs,
  unsafe JSON/XML utilities. Transitive deps on log4j 2.14.1, commons-text 1.8,
  jackson-databind 2.9.8, snakeyaml 1.26.
- vulnerable-service: Spring Boot microservice (port 9091) with taint relay to
  VulnerableApp, broken sanitizer usage, and path-traversal-prone file handling.

Supports local path and Maven artifact dependency modes via -PuseLocal flag.
